Track Liner Notes & Production Insights

Recorded between Berlin and Los Angeles, Midnight Dreams blends vintage analog synthesizers (specifically the Prophet-5 and Juno-106) with modern granular delay processing. Parker composed the main arpeggiated motif during an overnight train ride through the Swiss Alps, capturing the hypnotic rhythm of nocturnal travel.

Production Details

  • Composer & Producer: Alex Parker
  • Mixing Engineer: Marcus Thorne at Soundforge Studios
  • Mastering: Analog Tape 1/2" at Sterling Sound
  • BPM & Key: 118 BPM, F minor
"I wanted to craft a piece of music that feels like gazing through rain-streaked glass at midnight city lights—nostalgic yet forward-looking."

— Alex Parker
